sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Twitch Winter 2025 case (Epic) (Rivals) (Twitch 2025) is a Event Reward Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A case with some epic goodies.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Can only be opened outside of a raid
- Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")

sections.heading: Loot Table
sections.text: Each case contains various high-value loot and equipment including RShG-2 72.5mm rocket launcher, LEDX Skin Transilluminator, Physical Bitcoin, info items and keys & keycards.
